title: Inner shore
description: A close interior of the light-remodeled mineral: pale absorption sheets cross translucent green walls. A new macro photograph of a saved state.
interpretation: Camera, lens, lighting, contours and surface optical materials change; fields are unchanged. This is a new artwork from an existing state, not a new simulation or evidence of additional evolution.
